name: legacy_paper_benchmark
description: The original hardcoded 10-matchup benchmark, reproduced exactly. Same order, same 400 games/matchup, same --timeout 10, same seed base -- so task ids, seeds and result directory names are identical to the pre-config harness and an in-flight run resumes across the change. This is the config tools/benchmark_cluster.sh defaults to. Do not reorder or extend it.
